items.q: What ages and grades do you accept?
items.a: We work with students from grade 4 to grade 11. Groups are formed by level, not by age.

items.q: My child isn't at olympiad level yet. Is there a suitable group?
items.a: Yes. In the foundation / strengthening group we work on the basics of school maths and logic. As the student improves, they move to a stronger group.

items.q: How do the trial lessons work?
items.a: After signing up, the first two lessons are trial lessons: the student meets the group and the teacher, and the teacher assesses their level. Before that, you can take the free level test on our website.

items.q: What is the monthly mock exam?
items.a: Every month there is an exam in olympiad format. Based on the results, students are placed in level-based subgroups — a student who improves moves to a stronger group.

items.q: Can my child study online from another country?
items.a: Yes. Online lessons are live on Zoom or Google Meet, so students can join from any country. Individual lessons are also available.
In-person group in Baku: 1 lesson per week — 250 AZN per month, 2 lessons per week — 500 AZN per month. Ask us on WhatsApp for online and individual lesson prices.

items.q: Which olympiads do you prepare for?
items.a: The IMO, JBMO, RFO, BOM, IZhO, EGMO and national olympiads. Past problems and solutions for each olympiad are in the «Materials» section.
